posts.raw_content:
...No Jesus, No peace...Know Jesus, Know Peace...

“God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” —James 4:6

...Thru the Bible with Dr. J. Vernon McGee  Exodus 19:4-25...

God presents His people with two choices. They could either continue being led by His grace, or they could have an organized list of laws to keep for the rest of their lives. They decide to stick with what they know and choose the Law over grace. Perhaps Israel’s mistake in Exodus 19 isn’t too different from our own choices today. Don’t miss out on God’s grace, friends.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-with-j-vernon-mcgee/player/exodus-194-25-1294594.html?type=branded#now-playing

https://ttb.org/

...Thru the Bible - Minute with McGee  Dr. J. Vernon McGee...

Our high place

The Lord, when He redeemed us, He redeemed us by the blood of Christ; He paid a price. And now He’s given us as a gift back to the Lord Jesus Christ. We belong to Him. Now service to Him, friends, does not rest upon rules and regulations and laws. That’s not the way you serve the Lord Jesus. You serve Him now because you love Him. You’re in a new relationship to Him. You’ve been joined to Him; you’re part of Him. And what a thrill it is now to know you’re serving Him. And you’re not following little rules and regulations. You’ve been brought to a high place, and you want to please Him. How wonderful this is.

https://www.oneplace.com/ministries/thru-the-bible-minute-with-mcgee/listen/our-high-place-1294600.html

https://ttb.org/

...Daily Promises...

All things that the Father hath are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall shew [it] unto you. (John 16:15)

By His Spirit, God will take that which belongs to Jesus and make it known to us. Amazing! Thank Him for the revelation of His Word that he spoke through the apostles; our God is an awesome God!

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/promises/view.cfm

...Don't focus on the attention of others...

And the women answered one another as they played, and said, Saul hath slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands. -- 1 Samuel 18:7

We should not be so focused on the attention of others that we forget it is God we serve.

https://digginganotherwell.substack.com/p/dont-focus-on-the-attention-of-others



...C. H. Spurgeon's Evening Reading (September 23rd)...

"Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe." — Mark 9:23

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?Time=pm

C. H. Spurgeon's Morning Reading (September 24th)

"For I was ashamed to require of the king a band of soldiers and horsemen to help us against the enemy in the way: because we had spoken unto the king, saying, The hand of our God is upon all them for good that seek Him; but His power and His wrath is against all them that forsake Him." — Ezra 8:22

https://www.blueletterbible.org/devotionals/me/view.cfm?doy=268



...Faith Plus Nothing Equals Salvation...

https://youtu.be/fDR0mu18x80?si=aG5gQZZ3noLTFzQk

https://blueletterbible.org/Comm/mcgee_j_vernon/eBooks/faith-plus-zero-equals-salvation.cfm
